text: हिंदीत नसलेले नपुंसकलिंग मराठीत आहे. यांपैकी नपुंसकलिंगी शब्द कोणता?
gloss: Marathi has a neuter gender that Hindi lacks. Which of these words is neuter? — झाड (tree): 'ते झाड'; डोंगर and दिवा are masculine ('तो'), नदी feminine ('ती').

text: ‘एकोणपन्नास’ ही संख्या अंकांत कशी लिहाल?
gloss: How do you write 'ekonpannas' in digits? — 49: 'ekon-' means one short of, so 'one short of fifty'.

text: आज बुधवार आहे. ‘परवा आठवडी बाजार भरला होता’, तर तो कोणत्या वारी भरला होता?
gloss: Today is Wednesday. 'The weekly market was held parva.' On which day? — Monday: परवा means both the day after tomorrow and the day before yesterday; the past tense picks the latter (Friday is the autopilot trap).

text: आईच्या बहिणीला आपण मावशी म्हणतो; वडिलांच्या बहिणीला काय म्हणतो?
gloss: Mother's sister is 'mavshi'; what do we call father's sister? — Atya. Mami is mother's brother's wife, kaku father's brother's wife, vahini brother's wife.

text: पोळ्याच्या सणाला शेतकरी कोणाला सजवून त्यांची मिरवणूक काढतात?
gloss: On the Pola festival, whom do farmers decorate and parade? — Their bullocks, thanked for the year's ploughing.

text: दिवाळीच्या सुट्टीत महाराष्ट्रातली मुले अंगणात माती-दगडांनी काय उभारतात?
gloss: In the Diwali holidays, what do Maharashtrian children build of mud and stones in the yard? — A fort (killa), a tradition honouring Shivaji's forts.

text: “… घ्या, गोड गोड बोला” असे म्हणत मकर संक्रांतीला काय वाटतात?
gloss: 'Take ..., speak sweetly': what is handed out at Makar Sankranti with these words? — Tilgul (sesame and jaggery): «तिळगूळ घ्या, गोड गोड बोला».

text: झणझणीत तांबडा आणि पांढरा रस्सा ही कोणत्या शहराची खासियत?
gloss: The fiery red and white mutton curries (tambda and pandhra rassa) are the speciality of which city? — Kolhapur.

text: वेबसाइट उघडताना पडद्यावर ‘४०४’ असा क्रमांक आला, तर त्याचा अर्थ काय?
gloss: A web page shows '404'. What does it mean? — The page was not found (HTTP 404 Not Found).

text: कोकिळा आपली अंडी बहुधा कोणाच्या घरट्यात घालते?
gloss: In whose nest does the koel usually lay its eggs? — The crow's: the Asian koel is a brood parasite chiefly of crows.

text: प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये डाळ-भात पटकन का शिजतो?
gloss: Why do dal and rice cook fast in a pressure cooker? — Under pressure water boils above 100 °C (about 120 °C), so food cooks hotter.

text: पहाटे पूर्वेला लखलखणारी ‘शुक्राची चांदणी’ खरे तर काय आहे?
gloss: The 'star of Venus' shining in the east at dawn is really what? — A planet: Venus, called a 'star' in Marathi.

text: पेन ड्राइव्ह किंवा मेमरी कार्डची क्षमता कोणत्या एककात सांगतात?
gloss: In what unit is the capacity of a pen drive or memory card given? — Gigabytes.

text: बॅडमिंटनच्या ‘फुला’चा पसरट घेर पारंपरिकरीत्या कशापासून बनवतात?
gloss: The flared skirt of a badminton 'flower' (shuttlecock) is traditionally made of what? — Feathers (usually goose), set in a cork base.

text: लता मंगेशकरांची धाकटी बहीण असलेली नामवंत पार्श्वगायिका कोण?
gloss: Which renowned playback singer is Lata Mangeshkar's younger sister? — Asha Bhosle.

text: ‘झिंगाट’ गाण्यावर अख्खा महाराष्ट्र नाचला; हे गाणे कोणत्या चित्रपटातले?
gloss: All Maharashtra danced to 'Zingaat'; which film is it from? — Sairat (2016, Nagraj Manjule; music Ajay–Atul).

text: मोबाईलवरच्या चित्रचिन्हांसाठी वापरला जाणारा ‘इमोजी’ हा शब्द मूळ कोणत्या भाषेतला?
gloss: The word 'emoji' for phone picture symbols comes from which language? — Japanese: e (picture) + moji (character); not from English 'emotion'.

text: पंचतंत्राच्या गोष्टीत मगरीच्या बायकोला माकडाचे काय खायचे असते?
gloss: In the Panchatantra tale, what of the monkey does the crocodile's wife want to eat? — His heart; the monkey had fed them jamun, and escapes by saying he left his heart in the tree.

text: संत्र्यांसाठी प्रसिद्ध असलेली महाराष्ट्राची उपराजधानी कोणती?
gloss: Which city, famous for its oranges, is Maharashtra's second capital? — Nagpur, where the legislature's winter session sits.

text: दुबईला गेल्यावर खरेदी करताना कोणते चलन वापरावे लागते?
gloss: Shopping in Dubai, which currency do you use? — The UAE dirham. The riyal is Saudi, the dinar Kuwaiti/Bahraini, the lira Turkish.

text: पूर्व आशियाई पदार्थांतला पनीरसारखा दिसणारा ‘टोफू’ कशापासून बनतो?
gloss: Tofu, the paneer-like block of East Asian cooking, is made from what? — Soybeans (curdled soy milk), not dairy milk.

text: ‘महाराष्ट्र दिन’ म्हणून आपण कोणती तारीख साजरी करतो?
gloss: Which date do we celebrate as Maharashtra Day? — 1 May (the state was formed on 1 May 1960). 6 June is Shivrajyabhishek Din, 19 February Shiv Jayanti, 27 February Marathi Bhasha Din.

text: नॉर्स पुराणकथांमधला हातोडा घेतलेला थॉर हा कशाचा देव?
gloss: In Norse myth, hammer-wielding Thor is the god of what? — Thunder.

text: मर्यादित षटकांच्या क्रिकेटमध्ये फलंदाजाला ‘फ्री हिट’ कोणत्या चेंडूनंतर मिळते?
gloss: In limited-overs cricket, after which delivery does the batter get a 'free hit'? — A no-ball: the next ball is a free hit.

text: जगभर गाजलेली ‘स्क्विड गेम’ ही मालिका कोणत्या देशात बनली?
gloss: Where was the global hit series 'Squid Game' made? — South Korea (Netflix, 2021).

text: यूपीआयवर व्यवहार करताना यूपीआय पिन कधी टाकावा लागतो?
gloss: When do you have to enter your UPI PIN? — Only when paying (or checking your balance); never to receive money, the classic scam line.

text: जुन्या काळी रुपयाचे सोळा आणे होते. मग ‘चार आणे’ म्हणजे रुपयाचा किती भाग?
gloss: A rupee used to be sixteen annas. So 'four annas' is what part of a rupee? — A quarter (पाव): 4/16.

text: डोळा घारा आहे की काळा, हे डोळ्याचा कोणता भाग ठरवतो?
gloss: Which part of the eye decides whether it is grey-green or black? — The iris (बुबुळ); बाहुली is the pupil, always black.

text: ‘डोळ्यांत तेल घालून पहारा देणे’ म्हणजे कसा पहारा देणे?
gloss: 'To keep watch with oil in one's eyes' means keeping watch how? — With the utmost vigilance.

text: स्वातंत्र्याचा ‘अमृत महोत्सव’ किती वर्षे पूर्ण झाल्यावर साजरा झाला?
gloss: India's 'Amrit Mahotsav' of independence marked how many years? — 75 (2022). Suvarna = 50, Hirak = 60, Shatabdi = 100.

text: सुडोकूच्या प्रत्येक ओळीत १ ते ९ हे अंक एकदाच येतात. मग प्रत्येक ओळीची बेरीज किती?
gloss: Every Sudoku row holds 1 to 9 once each. What does each row add up to? — 45 (9×10/2).

text: ‘जलचर’ पाण्यात, ‘भूचर’ जमिनीवर राहतो. मग ‘उभयचर’ प्राणी कुठे वावरतो?
gloss: A 'jalachar' lives in water, a 'bhuchar' on land. Where does an 'ubhayachar' move about? — In water and on land: उभय = both (amphibian).

text: पेरूच्या डोंगरमाथ्यावरचे माचू पिचू कोणत्या प्राचीन संस्कृतीने वसवले?
gloss: Which ancient civilisation built Machu Picchu on a Peruvian ridge? — The Inca (15th century).

text: ‘रोबोट’ हा शब्द कोणत्या भाषेतील नाटकातून जगभर पोहोचला?
gloss: From a play in which language did the word 'robot' spread worldwide? — Czech: Karel Čapek's R.U.R. (1920), from 'robota', forced labour.

text: स्पेनचा प्रसिद्ध ‘पाएया’ मुख्यतः कशापासून बनतो?
gloss: Spain's famous paella is made mainly from what? — Rice, cooked in a wide shallow pan.

text: संगीत रंगभूमीवर स्त्रीभूमिका अजरामर करणारे नारायण श्रीपाद राजहंस कोणत्या नावाने ओळखले जातात?
gloss: Narayan Shripad Rajhans, who made women's roles immortal on the Marathi musical stage, is known by what name? — Balgandharva. The others are different singers.

text: टेनिसमध्ये शून्य गुणाला काय म्हणतात?
gloss: What is a score of zero called in tennis? — Love. A duck is a batsman's zero in cricket; deuce is 40–40.

text: निन्टेंडोच्या खेळांतला मिशीवाला मारियो व्यवसायाने काय आहे?
gloss: By trade, what is Nintendo's moustached Mario? — A plumber.

text: वारली चित्रांतील माणसे, झाडे आणि प्राणी मुख्यतः कोणत्या रंगाने रेखाटतात?
gloss: In Warli paintings, what colour are the people, trees and animals mainly drawn in? — White (rice paste) on an earthen background.

text: साप सारखी जीभ बाहेर काढतो, ती मुख्यतः कशासाठी?
gloss: Why does a snake keep flicking its tongue? — To smell: it carries scent particles to the Jacobson's organ in the roof of its mouth.

text: सकाळी उन्हात इंद्रधनुष्य दिसले, तर ते आकाशात कोणत्या दिशेला असेल?
gloss: A rainbow appears in the morning sunshine; in which direction is it? — West: a rainbow always stands opposite the sun, which is in the east in the morning.

text: ‘गेम ऑफ थ्रोन्स’ मालिका कोणत्या लेखकाच्या कादंबऱ्यांवर आधारित आहे?
gloss: 'Game of Thrones' is based on whose novels? — George R. R. Martin's 'A Song of Ice and Fire'.

text: बुलढाणा जिल्ह्यातले लोणार सरोवर कशामुळे तयार झाले?
gloss: What formed Lonar Lake in Buldhana district? — A meteorite impact; it is a crater lake in basalt.

text: मराठीत ‘द्न्य’ असा उच्चारला जाणारा ‘ज्ञ’ लिपीत कोणत्या दोन वर्णांचा जोड आहे?
gloss: 'ज्ञ', pronounced 'dnya' in Marathi, is written as a conjunct of which two letters? — ज् + ञ, though the sound is nothing like it.

text: हजार पौर्णिमा पाहिल्याचा ‘सहस्रचंद्रदर्शन’ सोहळा साधारण कोणत्या वयात करतात?
gloss: At about what age is the 'Sahasrachandradarshan' (having seen a thousand full moons) celebrated? — In the 81st year: 1000 full moons ÷ about 12.4 a year ≈ 80 years 8 months.

text: बुद्धिबळात ‘कॅसलिंग’ करताना राजासोबत कोणती सोंगटी जागा बदलते?
gloss: In chess, which piece moves together with the king when castling? — The rook (हत्ती, 'elephant', in Marathi).

text: मूळ संख्येला १ आणि ती स्वतः सोडून दुसरा विभाजक नसतो. यांपैकी मूळ संख्या कोणती?
gloss: A prime has no divisor but 1 and itself. Which of these is prime? — 53. 51 = 3×17, 57 = 3×19, 87 = 3×29: their digits add up to a multiple of 3.

text: १६६१ मध्ये पोर्तुगालकडून मुंबईची बेटे इंग्लंडच्या राजाला कशी मिळाली?
gloss: How did England's king get the islands of Bombay from Portugal in 1661? — As dowry, on marrying Catherine of Braganza (Charles II).

text: सूर्याचा प्रकाश पृथ्वीवर सुमारे आठ मिनिटांत पोहोचतो. चंद्रावरून परावर्तित होणारा प्रकाश किती वेळात पोहोचतो?
gloss: Sunlight reaches Earth in about eight minutes. How long does light reflected from the Moon take? — About a second (≈1.3 s for 384,000 km); 'eight minutes' is the autopilot trap.

text: भास्कराचार्यांच्या ‘सिद्धांतशिरोमणी’ ग्रंथातील अंकगणिताचा भाग कोणत्या नावाने ओळखला जातो?
gloss: What is the arithmetic part of Bhaskaracharya's 'Siddhanta Shiromani' called? — Lilavati. Bijaganita (algebra), Grahaganita and Goladhyaya are its other three parts.
